correctness.rationale: For A^d every valid fixed-depth prefix has one right residual; B^d has one at even and two at odd depths. The union has nonempty quotient widths 1,2,3 at internal even depths, 5 at nonterminal middle odd depths, 3 at the final odd depth, 1 at the end. Different depths have disjoint residual word lengths. Sum=8d−6 plus one shared dead state gives 8d−5. At depth 1 at most two prefixes, against product-rank allowance 5, loses 3; penultimate rank has at most three nonempty one-letter residuals, losing 2; all other ranks saturate. Check d=2 endpoint non-overlap and infinite d≥2 with Myhill–Nerode. Independent exact enumerator d2..6 confirms but does not prove all d.
